name: PostgreSQL driver implementation of Cross-Schema Queries
description: PostgreSQL CrossSchema driver for the dbxschema API: implements cross-schema Connection, Schema and DatabaseTool for PostgreSQL, including schema clone via a bundled pg-clone-schema SQL function.
project_description: PostgreSQL driver implementation of the Database Cross-Schema Queries (dbxschema) API. Registers a CrossSchema plugin (id/driver 'pgsql') that provides the PostgreSQL-specific cross-schema Connection, Schema and DatabaseTool classes, enabling a single SQL query to span multiple PostgreSQL schemas of one database. Submodule of drupal/dbxschema; requires core pgsql and dbxschema.
